signal.insertion_domain: low-dose INPUT slice (HU-space addition, before reconstruction)

location.note: lesion centred in the extracted tissue ROI patch

background.selection: find_tissue_roi: scores candidate patches by closeness to soft-tissue HU (band 10-120), low Sobel gradient (exp(-mean_grad/20)), and low internal std (exp(-std_hu/50)); deterministic RNG seed 42

cnr.definition: (mu_present - mu_absent) / sigma_absent, on model OUTPUT patches

npwe.type: non-prewhitening matched filter with eye filter

protocol.insertion_study: lesion inserted into low-dose INPUT; model reconstructs both lesion-present and lesion-absent inputs; detectability measured on model OUTPUTS
protocol.roi_reuse: tissue ROI chosen once from the first reference slice and reused across slices

rationale.blur_trap: a method that merely smooths (e.g. Gaussian blur, sigma=1.0, 5x5) destroys high-frequency signal content: on the LIDC simulated-dose pilot (v0.5) its CNR falls below Rose 3.0 even when PSNR rises; blur is a permanent control. On the AAPM real-paired held-out set (calibrated 2026-08-21) the insertion-based CNR/CHO/NPWE indices are NOT discriminative (blur CNR is the highest, CHO AUC saturates at 1.000 for all methods); the discriminative dimension on real anatomy is the frequency-domain high-frequency band-energy retention ratio (band_energy_ratio, see frequency_domain_detectability below), where blur retains 2.6-4.2x less 1-px-band energy than every learned baseline while scoring the highest SSIM
rationale.no_anatomy_roi: noise ROI constrained to tissue HU band + low gradient, never placed over anatomy (Rung 3)

calibration_note.scope: AAPM 2016 real paired held-out test (4 patients: L109/L192/L286/L333; train 3 / val 3 / test 4, splits/aapm_{train,val,test}.txt)
calibration_note.attempted_insertion_grid: contrast HU in {20,40,60} x sigma px in {0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,3} (plus 80HU/4px and disk micro-structures 15-240HU): CHO AUC saturated >=0.92-1.000 and blur-vs-model AUC gap <=0.02 in every grid cell -> insertion protocol is not discriminative on real anatomy (cross-slice background spread 65-75 HU dominates inserted-signal response 3-15 HU)
calibration_note.resolved_by: frequency-domain template/energy protocol (Section frequency_domain_detectability): band_energy_ratio separates blur (0.247 mean) from learned baselines (0.631-1.040 mean) by 2.6-4.2x on the same held-out test
calibration_note.status: detectability dimension calibrated and discriminative; task version v1 kept (signal/insertion parameters unchanged), frequency-domain protocol added as the calibrated discriminative index

frequency_domain_detectability.signal_model: 1-px high-frequency band h = img - G(sigma=1.0px)(img) in HU space (Gaussian high-pass residual)
frequency_domain_detectability.target_selection: find_micro_peak: local 32x32-px patch in the FD high-frequency residual with maximal HF energy, restricted to soft-tissue ROI (same tissue HU band as insertion ROI)

indices.band_energy_ratio: HF-band energy retention of the model output vs the full-dose reference: sum(o_hf^2) / sum(fd_hf^2), computed on the same 48-slice detection subset; blur (sigma=1.0) is expected to retain the least HF energy
indices.tm_auc: template-match AUC: correlation of the FD HF micro-structure template with the model output HF residual at the signal location (positive) vs an absent soft-tissue patch (negative), Mann-Whitney AUC

frequency_domain_detectability.calibrated_threshold: blur band_energy_ratio <= 0.35 vs learned baselines >= 0.60 on AAPM held-out test (2026-08-21, mean over 4 patients)
frequency_domain_detectability.rationale: A learned denoiser that preserves diagnostic microstructure must retain the 1-px high-frequency band of the real anatomy; a pure smoother (blur trap) erases that band while keeping PSNR/SSIM high. This makes the blur trap a 'high fidelity, low detectability' failure on real anatomy.

source_of_truth: baselines/src/pwm_ldct_baselines/observers.py (TaskSpec); this file is the published configuration mirror; per-model result JSONs under baselines/results/ embed the same parameters
